articles.title: Maternity care improvements linked to fewer stillbirths and newborn deaths in sub-Saharan Africa
articles.excerpt: A combination of training, quality improvement and leadership support in hospitals across four countries in sub-Saharan Africa is linked to fewer stillbirths and deaths among newborns during the first 24 hours of life, according to a study led by Karolinska Institutet and published in Nature Medicin
articles.summary: 一项发表于Nature Medicine的研究显示，撒哈拉以南非洲四国医院结合培训、质量改进和领导支持，与死产及新生儿出生24小时内死亡减少相关。

articles.title: Almost a third of women in their 20s have never been screened for cervical cancer
articles.excerpt: The percentage of women in their 20s who have never been screened for cervical cancer has been increasing at a disturbing rate over the past 20 years—to the point that almost a third of women ages 21 to 29 have never been screened.
articles.summary: 美国21至29岁女性中近三分之一从未接受过宫颈癌筛查，该比例在过去20年持续上升。
